svg.text: INSTRUCTIONAL MOCKUP — NOT A LIVE CAPTURE OR RESULT
Find the configuration NGINX actually loads
Application server (TLS-APP01) · RHEL 9 Bash terminal · learner@10.90.0.10
COMMAND / FILE CONTENT TO ENTER — PRESERVE CASE
EXPECTED RESULT / SIMULATED CLUE — CHECK YOUR OWN MACHINE
The printed configuration includes the main file and loaded .conf files; no TLS file appears yet
FOLLOW THE NUMBERED INSTRUCTIONS IN THE LESSON
1. Paste the command below. It tests the configuration, then prints the main file and included files.
2. Find /etc/nginx/nginx.conf and the include for /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf. Save a private note of these
paths; do not upload the full configuration.
3. On an existing authorized server, find a server block containing listen 443 ssl and server_name
app.example.mil. On our new VM there is no HTTPS block yet; that is expected.
No real private key, real certificate result, production access or DoD endorsement is shown.
